record.question: A closed bed is also known as:
record.explanation: Answer B: Empty bed. A closed bed is an unoccupied bed made with covers drawn up and tucked to the head; “empty bed” is the matching offered description, though not a precise synonym because an empty bed can also be open. Reference: https://elsevier-elibrary.com/contents/fullcontent/71232/epubcontent_v2/OEBPS/B9780729541107500417B.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
